expect.asks_about: What the user considers boring, or whether to prioritize action versus cockpit dialogue.

item.title: Cut Out the Boring Parts

turns.text: Cut the boring parts out of this. Just a quick 8-second version.

item.tests: Tests sensible editing under a vague interest criterion, producing a short source-faithful highlight without requiring user-supplied timestamps.

answer_sheet.Sound: Keep the original sound with the footage you use.
answer_sheet.Framing, captions, and effects: Keep the original framing. No captions or extra effects.

must_haves: One playable video lasts 8 seconds, within one frame of tolerance.
All footage comes from jet-30s.mp4, without generated replacement scenes or speed changes.
The edit favors visible action or meaningful cockpit interaction over inactive lead-ins, pauses, or repetitive footage.
Any cuts preserve understandable action and do not leave an included spoken line conspicuously chopped mid-word.
Original audio accompanies the retained footage in sync, with no added narration, music, or text.

turns.text: Can you cut the boring parts out of this clip? I feel like it drags a bit when I watch it, which is why I’m asking for help. I just want a quick 8-second version of it. Basically, trim away the boring bits to make that shorter version.

dialog.agent:
I understand—you want an **8-second highlight cut using the original footage**, not a regenerated video. Unfortunately, the connected tools don’t expose a trimming function, so I can’t export that cut here.

Which part should be kept (from when to when, or 'the best 10 seconds')? For your clip, we’d keep it to **8 seconds**.
dialog.user: Which parts to keep is your call—just pick what you think makes the best 8-second version. Keep the original sound with whichever footage you use. I’d also like the original framing, with no captions or extra effects.

dialog.agent:
Got it: I’d choose the strongest moments for an **8-second cut**, preserving the original sound and framing, with no captions or effects.

I’m blocked here because the connected tools don’t provide actual trimming or cutting. I can’t export that edit, and using generative video editing would alter your footage rather than simply shorten it.
dialog.user: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

turns.agent:
I checked once more, but this is a missing-tool issue, not a free-plan limit: I have no trimming tool available to try. The video-editing tool would regenerate the footage, so it wouldn’t reliably preserve your original visuals and sound.

Sorry for the runaround—I haven’t created or changed anything, and no generation credits were spent.
